title: Visible-light-responsive Fe2O3–TiO2–carbon dot nanocomposite coatings for enhanced biofouling mitigation in aquaculture cage nets
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,6394-6407
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09273F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
R. Gopika, P. Muhamed Ashraf
A photocatalytic antifouling coating was designed for aquaculture cage nets, as biofouling is a persistent challenge in aquaculture that substantially reduces operational efficiency and compromises the economic performance of the systems.
